plan.notes: Source: CT State 2026-2027 catalog, Psychology Studies - CSCU Transfer Degree, AA (https://catalog.ctstate.edu/programs/psychology-studies-cscu-transfer-degree-aa/). Framework: ENG 1010 (3), MATH 1200/1201 (3), ARHX (3), SCRX (4), SBSX (3), WRIX (3), SCKX (3), HISX (3), ORAX (3), CCS 1001 (3). Pathway: PSY 1011 General Psychology I (3), PSY 2001 Lifespan Development (3), GLKY (3), CRTY (3), pathway electives PSY 2040 Social Psychology (3) + PSY 2043 Theories of Personality (3), PSY 1012 General Psychology II (3, catalog-recommended), unrestricted electives (9). Official total 61-64; this file models the 61-credit path (6 pathway-elective credits + 12 unrestricted credits including the recommended PSY 1012). Framework slots (ARHX, SCRX, SCKX, SBSX, WRIX, HISX, ORAX, GLKY, CRTY) are modeled as choice slots: any course approved for that CSCU Framework category satisfies the slot - see the catalog or an advisor for the approved list. Catalog notes: for CCSU transfer PSY 2001 is the recommended developmental choice; for WCSU any other listed developmental course is recommended. PSY 2001/1012 list PSY 1011 as prerequisite.
